name: The Last Toast
source:
An evening of elegance, laughter, and fine company. But before the first toast is raised, the host is found dead. The doors are locked. The only way out? A series of puzzles left behind by an unseen hand.
Six guests. One deadly game. Chosen with purpose, bound by secrets.

Will you solve the mystery before the night is over? Or will you become a part of it? 

[From [url=https://studioshiraya.itch.io/the-last-toast]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个优雅、欢笑和美好陪伴的夜晚。但在第一次举杯之前，主人就被发现死了。门是锁着的。唯一的出路？一只看不见的手留下的一系列谜题。
六位客人。一场致命的游戏。有目的的选择，受秘密的约束。

你能在今晚结束之前解开这个谜团吗？或者你会成为其中的一部分吗？

[来自[url=https://studioshiraya.itch.io/the-last-toast]itch.io[/url]]
